name: Melanie Z, Germany
text: I spent a few days at LUMA's and had an extraordinary time there. Not only are the rooms wonderfully designed and kept, but the staff is also super nice and very helpful and friendly. They were always helping me out with every question I had, and always had a smile on their faces. The food from the next door Café that also is part of the place, is very delicious and I went there several times throughout the day just to relax, read and enjoy their homemade food.

name: Arun T, India
text: LUMA is a hidden gem in South Goa! If you are looking for a place to actually reset and disconnect, this is it. The A-frame huts are stunning-minimalist, super clean, and surprisingly spacious. The open-air bathroom was my favorite part; there's nothing like showering under the stars.

name: Stevie Hall, UK
text: We had a wonderful stay at Luma. The rooms are beautiful, bed sumptuous and to top it all, you have the sun and the stars above you when you shower. All of the staff are so friendly and efficient; their aim is clearly to ensure that you have a fabulous stay.

name: Marco, Netherlands
text: Great place to stay, very central location and yet really still and quiet between the trees. No noise at night and very cosy looking huts. A small boutique style venue with 9 generous sized A-frame huts. They have a very nice restaurant called Roots & Bloom onsite. The Headchef who designed the menu is a renowned vegetarian chef who has catered at retreats in various countries.

name: Harshal, India
text: A Slice of Paradise in Palolem. Hands down one of the most unique stays I've had in Goa. The cozy, tech-enabled cottages blend comfort with charm, but the real highlight? The open-roof bathroom—bathing under the stars with the sound of waves in the background was surreal and completely safe.

name: Gerald, Belgium
text: Peaceful and quiet, warm welcoming and kindness. Breakfast was very good. Yoga with Ravi this morning was amazing. Thank you.

name: Anthony, France
text: We spent five days at LUMA Goa to conclude our Indian adventure in December. We particularly enjoyed our stay at this establishment. The huts are beautiful and very comfortable: the quality of the bedding, cleanliness, security, amenities, air conditioning, bathrooms, showers… everything was excellent. The grounds are beautiful, pleasant, and tastefully decorated. The slight distance from the beach (a 2-minute walk) offers a true haven of tranquility.

name: Beatrice, Denmark
text: Luma Goa is absolutely wonderful. The design and the friendly service. The food and the restaurant - I loved it all - I will definitely be back.

name: Adi, Israel
text: Group of 5 vacationing with yoga. We liked the rooms, location, the delicious food in the cafe, the excellent massage, beautiful shala, hospitable staff and clean and beautifully designed property.

name: Nicole, United States
text: Beautiful cabins close to the beach. This place is beautiful. The cabins are spacious, clean, and very comfortable. The grounds are beautiful and well maintained. The location is also fantastic - just a couple minute walk to the beach. I wish we could have stayed longer.

name: Sarah, Costa Rica
text: Great location, away from the busy road, nice and quiet. Super comfortable a-frame cabin.

name: Tarasha, India
text: Amazing Experience. The location of the stay was amazing. It is a 1-minute walk to Palolem Beach and a 2 min walk to the beach road with multiple foods and drinks outlets and whatnot. The cottages were beautiful and very, very comfortable. The open-air washrooms were so beautiful and aesthetic. I would definitely recommend it.
